path.id: Know where to park before you arrive.

Finding parking can mean circling unfamiliar streets without knowing which spaces are available or what they cost. Once parked, keeping track of time and extending the stay can add further uncertainty.
The flow connects nearby options, duration and payment to an entry pass. The active session keeps the remaining time and extension action together.
Search near the destination, not only your current position.
Keep the active session visible after booking.
See where each option sits before choosing.
Extend time from the active session.
Compare distance, facilities and spaces before booking.
Availability helps narrow the parking options.
Use the pass to connect booking with entry.
Distance, facilities, price and availability help compare spaces before booking.
The confirmation links the reservation to a slot, location and QR entry pass.
Can someone find their pass and extend a session? Availability and entry depend on operator integration.
